name: Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono
positioning: Ski-in, ski-out mountain resort at Hanazono in Niseko, Hokkaido, with views of Mount Yotei and the Annupuri ranges
best_for: Skiers and snowboarders who want ski-in, ski-out access
Golfers who want Hanazono Golf next to the resort
Families or groups who want a residence with a full kitchen

facts.text: The resort has views across the Annupuri ranges and Mount Yotei.
Guests can ride the ski slopes from Mount Annupuri to Hanazono.
The hotel has onsen baths and a fitness center.
Summer activities at Niseko Hanazono Resort include the Hanazono Zipflight, rafting and tree trekking.
The hotel works closely with local farmers and markets.
Moliere Montagne serves Hokkaido ingredients prepared with traditional French techniques.
Moliere Montagne is an independent restaurant not operated by the hotel.
At Robata, seafood and local produce are grilled over charcoal.
Teppan serves traditional Japanese and French inspired menus at teppan counters.
China Kitchen serves Cantonese and Sichuan cuisine.
Deli showcases Pierre Hermé luxury patisserie.
The residences have a fully equipped island kitchen and an in-unit washer and dryer.

highlights.text: The hotel has ski-in and ski-out facilities.
The Annupuri and Yotei signature suites have views of Mount Yotei, a private onsen, and a terrace and veranda.
The spa has single and couples treatment rooms with private onsen.
Hanazono Golf, adjacent to the resort, is an 18-hole course with views of Mount Yotei.
Sushi Mitsukawa serves Kanazawa-influenced sushi and sashimi.

considerations.text: It takes approximately 150 minutes between New Chitose Airport and the hotel.
Indoor parking has a fee and limited outdoor parking is complimentary.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing during peak ski season.
